answer: Progressive quotas cap new identities at 2 slots, plus 2 per verified epoch to 40, minus 4 after 3 idle. Fraud resets the quota to 2, freezes rewards 6 epochs; repeats double the climb-back. Break-even: 40 slots take 19 epochs of real work, 152,000 units per 1,000 identities. A copper lock blocks buying full quotas; a river of fakes stays at 2 slots each. An onyx-hard reset wipes progress on first fraud; faking turns negative past 12%.
